description: Agent time. The current UTC instant for agents with no clock: unix seconds and milliseconds, ISO 8601 and RFC 2822 renderings, and the UTC calendar breakdown with weekday, month, day of year, ISO week, quarter, and leap year, answered fresh on every call. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: agent-time
